tips.text: Hit the daily cap with mission affinity first, then turn in Syndicate Alert rewards and medallions, which ignore the cap.
Cap the day fast in Elite Sanctuary Onslaught or the Duviri Circuit past stage 4, with an affinity booster running.
Use Primed Animal Instinct or another loot radar to find medallions; Khora and a wide-range Limbo are the usual frames.
Level fresh weapons and frames while you cap; the same affinity pays for Mastery and standing.
Rank up before your next mission or medallion turn-in; standing past a rank's maximum is lost.
Pledge Red Veil directly to climb fastest, or pledge Steel Meridian instead to keep Suda and Hexis and let Red Veil climb at half rate.
Bank standing with Cephalon Suda or Arbiters of Hexis first if you hold a high rank there; Red Veil gains drain them.
Collect the 5 Aya along the way so it never blocks Revered or Exalted.
Players treat the syndicate climb as a slow background grind, a couple of weeks at the daily cap.
